DestructiveConfirm.note: Open modal over the dimmed overlay: DS card panel, shadow-modal, close affordance, ghost cancel and red destructive confirm. Long real copy wraps correctly inside the max-w-[34rem] shell.

PrimaryConfirm.note: Same shell with confirmVariant="primary" — white primary button reads clearly distinct from the destructive cell.

LoadingConfirm.note: loading renders the spinner inside the confirm button and dims both actions; the disabled cancel is visibly muted.

CloseDisabled.note: disableClose renders the close glyph in its disabled ink while the footer stays actionable — the variant axis is visible against the other three cells.
